teams.name: Cotes AI
teams.description:
Cotes is building an autonomous trading system designed to detect major price displacements as they unfold — and trade them in real time.

We use advanced signal processing and AI to extract structure from market data that conventional indicators and statistical approaches miss. Instead of predicting an exact future price, Cotes identifies high-confidence directional opportunities as they develop.

For the WeAreDevelopers Hackathon, we're connecting the Cotes signal engine directly to the Alpaca Trading API, creating an automated pipeline from market data → signal → decision → execution.

The goal is bigger than a single strategy or market. Our architecture is designed to operate across equities, ETFs, crypto, and other liquid markets, with Alpaca providing the infrastructure to turn our signals into real-world trades.

Cotes finds the signal. Alpaca executes the trade.

teams.name: RevenueFlow
teams.description:
RevenueFlow — the reception desk that actually listens.

In Latin America, WhatsApp isn't a channel: it's the phone. Small businesses
run entirely inside it, and their customers don't type — they talk. Every CRM
renders a voice note as a grey box saying "audio message", and a human still
has to listen, understand, open a calendar and reply.

RevenueFlow turns a Spanish or Portuguese WhatsApp voice note into a booked
appointment in under 10 seconds. Built on AssemblyAI: Universal-3.5 Pro for
speech, biased with the business's own service catalog, and LLM Gateway for
intent — against a strict schema.

The rule the product rests on: the model decides what the customer wants, the
system decides what's allowed. It cannot invent a service, a date or an
availability slot. Complaints and payments escalate to a human.

Multi-country from line one: Venezuela and Brazil, each with its currency,
tax ID, language and tone.

Live: revenueflow-ai-yanero.vercel.app

teams.name: CrowdTwin AI
teams.description:
CrowdTwin AI is an AI-powered market simulation platform that creates a virtual crowd of diverse AI agents to test products, pricing, advertisements, and marketing strategies before real-world launch.

Each AI agent represents a different customer persona with unique demographics, preferences, budgets, motivations, and purchasing behavior. These agents independently evaluate a product or campaign, make simulated purchasing decisions, and explain the reasons behind their choices.

CrowdTwin AI then analyzes thousands of these interactions to identify customer objections, estimate purchase intent, compare strategies, perform virtual A/B testing, and generate actionable insights.

By leveraging parallel AI inference on AMD GPU infrastructure, CrowdTwin AI aims to make large-scale consumer simulation fast and scalable — helping businesses understand how different audiences may react before spending time and money on a real launch.
